name: 84404 · Ogden, UT
findings: ZIP 84404 (Ogden) has 106 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84404 (Ogden) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84404 (Ogden) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 37% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
